text: Hey boss. What can I do for you?
On the lowest dungeon to the highest peak I fought him, the bow robin of Moltgos.
At the last, I threw down my enemy and smote his ruin upon my mountain side.
Dockels took me. Dice made out of thought. Stars. Every day was a slumber on the life edge of the earth. I did what not here. I felt life to beat me again.
I've been sent back until my task was done.
Scrap off the crack. That was my bag. Scrap off. I am.
And I come back to you now. At the turn of the time, one stage of your journey is over. Another begins. War has come to Rohan. Give us ride to Edirus with all speed.
Okay, sleeping. Wake me when you need something.
